tosText:
1. REFUND POLICY
All purchases made on the RX-Gaming store are final. Virtual items are delivered instantly in-game, and we do not offer refunds, chargebacks, or reversals under any circumstances.

2. SERVER RULES & LIABILITY
By using this store, you agree to abide by all standard network rules. Any severe in-game infractions or cheating can result in a permanent ban from our platforms, and purchasing packages does not exempt your account from punishment. We hold no liability for virtual losses incurred during gameplay.

3. VIRTUAL DELIVERY GATEWAY
Items will automatically execute via Tebex commands within 5-15 minutes of checkout completion. Ensure your Minecraft character inventory has free open inventory slots before checking out. If delivery fails due to a full inventory, contact server support immediately.

4. CHARGEBACK & FRAUD POLICY
Any attempt to initiate a chargeback, claim dispute, or payment reversal through PayPal, Stripe, credit card companies, or banking institutions will result in an immediate, automated, and permanent network-wide blacklist of your Minecraft account, IP address, and email identifier. We provide full terminal command logs to payment processors to resolve fraud cases.

5. PARENTAL CONSENT CLAUSE
Players under the age of 18 must obtain explicit permission from a parent or legal guardian before making any financial transactions on the RX-Gaming web store. By completing a checkout session, you confirm that you have full authorization to use the payment method provided.
privacyText:
1. DATA COLLECTION
We collect your Minecraft username and email address solely to process checkout orders and deliver virtual items securely through the Tebex gateway network.

2. SECURITY PRIVACY
Your confidential data information is never sold, traded, or distributed to any unauthorized third-party platforms. Payment details are handled securely by Tebex's processing terminals.
rulesText:
1. FAIR PLAY & MODIFICATIONS
Cheating, modifying your game client to gain an unfair competitive advantage, or exploiting server glitches is strictly forbidden. Any automated macro networks or cross-teaming will result in a permanent account ban.

2. CHAT BEHAVIOR & CONDUCT
Keep chat civil and toxic-free. Harassment, racism, hate speech, severe insults, or excessive spamming inside global channels will result in an immediate mute or server infraction penalty.

3. EXPLOITS, DUPES & SECURITY
Any form of item duplication glitches or malicious server botting will result in an immediate blacklist and a full wipe of all your server-side profile data collections. Security of your account remains your responsibility.
discordRulesText:
1. PROFILE INTEGRITY
Usernames, nicknames, avatars, and custom status fields must remain appropriate. Impersonating staff team members or other prominent community players is strictly forbidden.

2. CHANNEL ETIQUETTE
Use channels for their intended purposes. Do not spam text strings, excessively tag roles, flood voice chats, or post unsolicited advertising links or direct messages to members.

3. CIVIL CONDUCT
Treat every community member with respect. Toxicity, harassment, flame wars, slurs, and political arguments are entirely prohibited and will result in an immediate server kick or ban penalty.

4. SAFETY & PERSONAL PRIVACY WARNING
Never give out your personal details, home addresses, phone numbers, real-life names, or account passwords under any circumstances. Staff members will NEVER ask for your password or confidential login information. Be cautious of malicious users sending unauthorized direct messages.

5. ADULT CONTENT & MALICIOUS LINKS
Posting NSFW (Not Safe For Work) text, images, videos, or links to illegal or dangerous external download platforms is strictly prohibited. Keep all community text streams family-friendly.

6. SUPPORT TICKET ETIQUETTE
Do not abuse the support ticket billing channels or submit joke requests. Spanning or pinging individual developers repeatedly within an open issue thread will delay your assistance and can result in your support privileges being temporarily revoked.
